newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: ZCCM LOSES HALF-DAY OUTPUT AFTER TREMOR.
newsitem.headline: ZCCM LOSES HALF-DAY OUTPUT AFTER TREMOR.

text.p: Zambia Consolidated Copper Mines (ZCCM) said on Friday that its Mufulira underground mine lost a half-day's output on Thursday after an earth tremor forced it to evacuate staff from the mine.
"We lost half a day's production because of the evacuation. We produced 2,000 tonnes of ore instead of the usual 4,000 tonnes," a company spokesman told Reuters.
A chain of seismic movements caused support pillars in parts of the mine to collapse and affected the air flow underground, forcing management to evacuate all staff.
The spokesman said no one was injured and no damage was done to the mine's crucial equipment and that normal production resumed on Friday morning.
"Apart from the break yesterday, the incident has had no impact on production," the spokesman said.
